content.mission: Act as Incident Manager under the Home Front Crisis Management System, responsible for the consequence management of major disasters and civil emergencies.

sequence.label: Incident Manager
sequence.action: Take charge as Incident Manager for the consequence management of the major disaster or civil emergency.

sequence.label: Coordinate services
sequence.action: Ensure effective coordination between SCDF and the other emergency services.

sequence.label: Whole of government
sequence.action: Work within the national structure: the Homefront Crisis Executive Group coordinates across agencies and reports to the ministerial committee chaired by the Minister for Home Affairs.

hand_offs.when: Casualties need management at the incident site and in public hospitals and polyclinics.
The crisis needs whole-of-government coordination through the HCEG and HCMC.

review.notes: SCDF's tiered escalation (basic and enhanced task forces, Operations Civil Emergency with the Commissioner as overall Incident Manager) is described in an SCDF case study of one named incident; excluded under WS9 6.19.
